due_when.clears_when: ict-bot-arm .git is under ~3 GB, or a measured du shows the cache blobs were never packed and nothing is needed
due_when.event: the VM-SPARSE-SYNC PR is deployed on ict-bot-arm (second pull-and-deploy after merge)

observation.what: size of .git on ict-bot-arm after the sparse deploy

origin.ref: lane VM-SPARSE-SYNC (manager session_01AFoLuJ1apgy8sfngu4WyNH dispatch, 2026-11-02; incident #22365 filled ict-bot-arm's 45G disk)
origin.rerun: vm-diag read: du -sh /home/ubuntu/ict-trading-bot/.git ; df -h / ; git -C /home/ubuntu/ict-trading-bot count-objects -vH

what: The live VM's .git object store still holds the #22365 cache blobs (they stay reachable through main's history even after #22374 deletes them from the tree), so VM-SPARSE-SYNC frees the working-tree copy only. Measure `du -sh /home/ubuntu/ict-trading-bot/.git` after the sparse deploy; if it is still multi-GB, add an allowlisted system-action that drops already-fetched large blobs from the now-partial clone (git >= 2.43 `git repack -a -d --filter=blob:limit=5m` with the promisor remote set, or a fresh `--filter=blob:limit=5m` re-clone swapped in under the running trader with no restart), never touching /data/bot-data.
